one_line: Chandela rulers of Kalinjar during the Ghurid siege, one negotiating its fall and the other leading its recovery.

appearance.age_look: Paramardi appears in his late 40s with a dignified but battle-worn build; Trailokyavarman appears in his early 30s with a lean, athletic frame.
appearance.face: Paramardi has a broad oval face, medium-deep wheat complexion, strong nose, neatly trimmed medium-length moustache and short beard, with calm, introspective eyes and a default expression of controlled worry; Trailokyavarman has a slightly sharper face, similar complexion, clean-shaven jaw with a fine upper moustache and intense focused eyes, default expression resolute and alert.
appearance.hair: Both have dark brown-black hair; Paramardi’s hair is tied back in a low, neat warrior’s knot under a narrow gold and red cloth turban band with a single small central plume; Trailokyavarman wears his hair in a higher topknot bound with a plain dark-red cloth band and no plume.
appearance.costume: Paramardi wears a knee-length, long-sleeved quilted war-kurta of thick cotton in muted saffron-ochre with fine red edging, over a fitted sleeveless mail shirt hinted beneath the neckline; around his waist is a broad red cotton kamarband with a subtle gold border, securing a pleated off-white cotton dhoti that falls to his ankles and is tucked for riding, with a second draped dhoti layer forming a front panel; he has a simple, era-accurate rectangular red-ochre angavastra shawl with a woven geometric border (mustard and dark red) folded over his left shoulder; his feet wear sturdy dark-brown leather sandals with straps; his jewellery is restrained: a single thin gold neck torque, small round gold earrings, a simple armlet on his right arm, and an iron signet ring on his sword hand; Trailokyavarman wears a similar but slightly lighter-weight quilted cotton coat in deep indigo-blue with white stitch lines and muted red piping, shorter at mid-thigh for agility, over a visible riveted mail shirt reaching to his hips; his dhoti is tightly wrapped in dull off-white with a narrow indigo border and tied higher for ease of movement; he wears a darker indigo kamarband, a plain brown leather belt for his sword, and a dark-red cotton shawl slung across his back like a short cloak; his sandals are similar but reinforced with an extra strap; his only jewellery is a simple copper armlet and small silver earrings, emphasizing a practical warrior image.
appearance.signature: Paramardi carries a single broad-bladed straight Indian sword (early khandā-like form) with a slightly flared tip, plain iron hilt and round pommel, worn at his left hip; Trailokyavarman carries a long, gently curving Bundelkhand-style sword with a simple disc pommel and leather-wrapped grip, kept sheathed at his left hip and often held in his right hand during tense scenes.

ref_desc: Paramardi and Trailokyavarman are two Chandela princes: Paramardi older with a saffron-ochre quilted war-kurta, off-white dhoti, red shawl, low knot and small plume, straight sword at his hip; Trailokyavarman younger in indigo quilted coat, higher knot, red shawl-cloak and curved sword.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of two distinct but coordinated Chandela rulers from early 13th-century Kalinjar, fully clothed in era-accurate Bundelkhand war dress: Paramardi is older, broad-faced and dignified, with wheat complexion, neat moustache and short beard, hair in a low knot under a narrow gold and red cloth turban band with one small plume; he wears a muted saffron-ochre long-sleeved quilted war-kurta over a subtly visible mail shirt, a broad red cotton kamarband, an off-white ankle-length dhoti with a tucked riding fold, a red-ochre angavastra shawl with mustard and dark-red geometric border over his left shoulder, simple leather sandals, small gold earrings, a thin gold neck torque, one armlet and an iron signet ring, and carries a broad-bladed straight Indian sword with plain iron hilt and round pommel at his left hip. Trailokyavarman is leaner and younger with a sharper face, wheat complexion, intense eyes, small moustache and clean-shaven jaw, hair in a higher topknot bound with a dark-red cloth band; he wears a deep indigo-blue mid-thigh quilted cotton coat with white stitch lines and red piping over a visible mail shirt, a tightly wrapped off-white dhoti with an indigo border tied high for movement, an indigo kamarband, a brown leather sword belt, a dark-red shawl slung across his back like a short cloak, reinforced sandals, small silver earrings and a copper armlet, and carries a long gently curving Bundelkhand-style sword with disc pommel at his left hip, often gripped in his right hand; keep the palette to saffron-ochre, deep indigo, muted red, off-white and dark brown, and show them side by side in neutral poses clearly displaying face details, hairstyles, garments and weapons for consistent redrawing.
